string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: Pair without a PC now confirms on screen: a big “Paired successfully ✓” notice, and then whether the launcher’s own shell is working
Smoother home screen: moving through the cross redraws less on each frame
Copying files from the computer to the TV over the network drive is faster (disk and network work at the same time)

Copying a big file from the computer to the TV (This PC › TV) went faster than before?
